567641d4-691b-4d2e-9766-fa57488f1508/Eve.ru: - Хо! Вы так близко подходите ко мне, потому что у вас есть чувства ко мне, мисс?<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> хмыкнул. Тогда он действительно подошел к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

5acc66cc-4991-4b9a-8c37-9d79261a9d22/Eve.en: The Liao River stretched as far as the eye could see, and Mount Yan towered up toward the sky.<NL>Liaodong was a faraway place, the Liao River hard to cross, the ancient gate towers in utter disrepair.<NL><NL>The two arrived at the bank and saw that the long river was serpentine.<NL>There was no telling where it rose, or where it ended. It was rushing inexorably forwards, seemingly boundless...<NL>In the distance, yellowish clouds veiled the river and the ground, obscuring everything within...
5acc66cc-4991-4b9a-8c37-9d79261a9d22/Eve.cn: 辽水无极，雁山参云。<NL>辽东万里辽水曲，古戍无城复无屋。<NL><NL>二人来到江水之畔，只见长河蜿蜒，<NL>不知从何处而始，到何处而终，只见滔滔滚滚，无边无极……<NL>远处黄云盖地，遮住江水，渺渺茫茫……

68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Eve.en: The azure ox, aimlessly carrying <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and <Character key= Participant str=Name /> around,<NL>arrived at a river whose name was unknown. Its banks were overgrown with weeds, which was a very desolate scene...<NL>On the shoal in the middle of the river, a broken sword could be seen sticking in the ground. A chill wind blew by, chilling them to the bones...
68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Eve.cn: 青牛带着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />与<Character key= Participant str=Name />左逛右走，<NL>来到一处不知名的河流之畔，只见荒草漫漫，苍凉不已……<NL>河中浅滩之上，有残剑斜立于地面，风萧萧而至，令人生寒……
68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Eve.ru: Лазурный бык, бесцельно несущий <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> и <Character key= Participant str=Name /> вокруг,<NL>прибыли к реке, название которой было неизвестно. Его берега заросли сорняками, что представляло собой очень пустынное зрелище...<NL>На отмели посреди реки виднелся воткнутый в землю сломанный Меч. Дул холодный ветер, пробирая их до костей...

68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Opt.en: The Crane of Liaoyang returned to its homeland and then soared into the sky.
68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Opt.cn: 辽阳之鹤，归返故地，冲天而去？
68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Opt.ru: Ляоянский журавль вернулся на свою родину и затем взмыл в небо.

68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Opt.cn: 此情此景实在奇特莫名……
68832c7b-24cf-449e-a602-8fdfefd56c0f/Opt.ru: Эта сцена в высшей степени необычна...

7f6d3b7c-aa29-45bb-9ae1-81ee63cd71d2/Eve.en: The white horse could perceive people's feelings. Ashamed that it had picked the wrong person for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>it actually let out a long neigh and started galloping like crazy with <Character key= Participant str=Name /> on its back.<NL>Before long, they disappeared from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s sight...
7f6d3b7c-aa29-45bb-9ae1-81ee63cd71d2/Eve.cn: 白马通灵，此时察觉自己为<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />选错了良人，十分赧颜，<NL>竟长嘶一声，载着<Character key= Participant str=Name />发足奔逃，<NL>不多时，便消失在了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前……
7f6d3b7c-aa29-45bb-9ae1-81ee63cd71d2/Eve.ru: Белый конь мог воспринимать чувства людей. Стыдно, что он выбрал не того человека для <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>он действительно издал протяжное ржание и начал скакать как сумасшедший со <Character key= Participant str=Name /> на спине.<NL>Вскоре они исчезли из <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />это зрение...

80dc9a12-c3a2-43b4-8d99-4c07ce7bed42/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> traveled throughout the steppes but did not see another participant...<NL>And the white horse was gone, so <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had no choice but to ride the azure ox back to the encampment...
80dc9a12-c3a2-43b4-8d99-4c07ce7bed42/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />游遍草原，却并未再见到任何一名参与者……<NL>白马也不知何处去了，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只得骑着青牛返回营地……
80dc9a12-c3a2-43b4-8d99-4c07ce7bed42/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> путешествовал по степям, но не встретил ни одного участника...<NL>А белый конь исчез, так что <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> у меня не было другого выбора, кроме как вернуться в лагерь верхом на лазурном быке...

84c86a69-eeea-4471-b43a-0be608b6542a/Eve.en: <Character key= Participant str=Name />, at the sight of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, hurriedly rode up to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and said,<NL>"The white horse knew my intention and took me to this place, but I wonder if you..."
84c86a69-eeea-4471-b43a-0be608b6542a/Eve.cn: <Character key= Participant str=Name />一见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，忙驱马至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身前，说道：<NL>“白马知晓我的心意，带着我来到此地，只是不知姑娘……”
84c86a69-eeea-4471-b43a-0be608b6542a/Eve.ru: <Character key= Participant str=Name /> увидев <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, поспешно подъехал к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> и сказал,<NL>"Белый конь понял мое намерение и доставил меня в это место, но мне интересно, не ты ли..."

88f879d3-fe32-40f8-96ab-c41d25a4c55d/Eve.en: <Character key= Participant str=Name /> escaped from here...

89dece89-5f88-4c19-8e9a-1f3c2273c92f/Eve.en: It was a sunny and breezy day.<NL><Character key=Participant str=Name /> was given <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand in marriage on the steppes, with the White Horse & Azure Ox as their matchmaker.<NL>Amidst the nomads' voices of benediction, the pair went through the wedding ceremony and officially united in marriage...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and <Character key=Participant str=Name /> have been pronounced wife and husband...)</color>
89dece89-5f88-4c19-8e9a-1f3c2273c92f/Eve.cn: 是日，天朗气清，微风和煦，<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />以白马青牛为媒，在草原之上迎娶了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>在草原之民的道贺声中，<Character key= Participant str=Name />与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />拜了天地，结为了夫妻……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />与<Character key=Participant str=Name />结为了夫妻……）</color>

8a4a9b40-5d76-468f-a943-6010b606be1a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, sitting astride the azure ox, was roaming the steppes when suddenly a figure galloped in her direction.<NL>It was <Character key= Participant str=Name />, who seemed to be trailing the white horse!
8a4a9b40-5d76-468f-a943-6010b606be1a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />正乘着青牛在草原上四处游逛，身旁忽然驰来一道身影，<NL>原来乃是<Character key= Participant str=Name />，他似乎是在追踪白马！
8a4a9b40-5d76-468f-a943-6010b606be1a/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> Она сидела верхом на лазурном быке и бродила по степи, как вдруг в ее сторону галопом поскакала какая-то фигура.<NL>Это было <Character key= Participant str=Name />, который, казалось, следовал за белым конем по пятам!

8cb3e768-163c-467d-aae9-e4e273711f68/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, unwilling to help <Character key= Participant str=Name />, roamed the steppes astride the azure ox alone...
8cb3e768-163c-467d-aae9-e4e273711f68/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不欲襄助<Character key= Participant str=Name />，自行乘着青牛在草原闲游……
8cb3e768-163c-467d-aae9-e4e273711f68/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, не желая помогать <Character key= Participant str=Name />, в одиночестве бродил по степям верхом на лазурном быке...

929add6b-3016-4cd0-8228-ed98dff8548c/Eve.en: The azure ox, as if having perceived <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s intention, started galloping west with the two on its back.<NL>Before long, the two spotted the white horse on the steppes!
929add6b-3016-4cd0-8228-ed98dff8548c/Eve.cn: 青牛有灵，似乎通晓了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的心意，载着二人向草原西面疾驰而去，<NL>不多时，二人便在草原上发现了白马的身影！
929add6b-3016-4cd0-8228-ed98dff8548c/Eve.ru: Лазурный бык, словно угадав намерение <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, поскакал на запад, неся на спине этих двоих.<NL>Вскоре эти двое заметили в степи белого коня!

9b96e300-22ac-4d16-92c2-c1eeba0cbce0/Eve.en: The azure ox, as if having perceived something, carried <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> forward at a gentle pace...<NL>Only then did <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> see clearly that the man astride the white horse was none other than <Character key= Participant str=Name />!
9b96e300-22ac-4d16-92c2-c1eeba0cbce0/Eve.cn: 青牛似有所感，载着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />缓步向前走去……<NL>这时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />方才看清，那乘着白马的男子，正是<Character key= Participant str=Name />！
9b96e300-22ac-4d16-92c2-c1eeba0cbce0/Eve.ru: Лазурный бык, словно что-то почувствовав, понес <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> двигайтесь вперед в медленном темпе...<NL>Только тогда я понял <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> ясно вижу, что человек верхом на белом коне был не кто иной, как <Character key= Participant str=Name />!

9b96e300-22ac-4d16-92c2-c1eeba0cbce0/Opt.en: (Take off the veil to meet him...)

9d2e27d3-d344-4b36-b2f7-350d91ca3b1d/Eve.en: "This place you took me to is indeed more eye-opening than those views. My trip is not wasted..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> couldn't help but offer some praises at the sight of the scene...
9d2e27d3-d344-4b36-b2f7-350d91ca3b1d/Eve.cn: “姑娘带我来到此处，确实比那些风物更奇，也算不虚此行……”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />看到此景，不禁出言赞道……
9d2e27d3-d344-4b36-b2f7-350d91ca3b1d/Eve.ru: "Место, куда вы меня отвезли, действительно открывает больше возможностей, чем те виды. Моя поездка не пропала даром..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> не мог удержаться, чтобы не похвалить это место...

abfcc4ce-4d8d-464c-bcad-ffd324120497/Eve.en: <NL>"Many residents of this place have shared ancestors: the god whose mount was a white horse and the goddess driving a gray buffalo-drawn carriage.<NL>They met on Woodleaf Hill and got married, and we're all their descendants...<NL>That is the origin of our spouse-seeking custom..."<NL><NL>An old nomad, telling the tale of the White Horse & Azure Ox, looked smilingly at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>"I hope the white horse finds you a suitable husband as well..."
abfcc4ce-4d8d-464c-bcad-ffd324120497/Eve.cn: <NL>“咱们辽地许多人的祖先呐，是那乘白马的神人，和驾青牛车的天女，<NL>二人在木叶山相遇，结成了夫妻，后来才有我们子子孙孙……<NL>咱们辽人招亲的习俗，就是来源于此……”<NL><NL>一名年长的牧民讲述着白马青牛的故事，含笑看向了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>“愿白马这次，也能为姑娘选出心仪的郎君……”

af66ee6d-3b5d-4ddd-a713-f58af1a7c5f5/Eve.en: "I have no quarrel with you, Miss. Why are you trying to stop me...?"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> fended off <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s blow, and then spoke with hands folded...
af66ee6d-3b5d-4ddd-a713-f58af1a7c5f5/Eve.cn: “我与姑娘无冤无仇，姑娘为何出手阻拦……”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />出手挡住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一击，拱手说道……
af66ee6d-3b5d-4ddd-a713-f58af1a7c5f5/Eve.ru: "Я не собираюсь с вами ссориться, мисс. Почему вы пытаетесь меня остановить?.."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> парировал удар <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, а затем заговорил, сложив руки на груди...

b410b453-ce0e-4941-a727-19fc4319ba53/Eve.en: "Nothing beats having a tour with you!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> reined in his horse to have it go at a gentle pace, riding shoulder to shoulder with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
b410b453-ce0e-4941-a727-19fc4319ba53/Eve.cn: “你我一路游玩逗趣，自然最有意思！”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />勒马徐行，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />比肩同游……
b410b453-ce0e-4941-a727-19fc4319ba53/Eve.ru: "Ничто не сравнится с поездкой с тобой!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> придержал коня, чтобы тот шел легким шагом, и ехал плечом к плечу с <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

b410b453-ce0e-4941-a727-19fc4319ba53/Opt.en: (Travel and enjoy the view with him...)
b410b453-ce0e-4941-a727-19fc4319ba53/Opt.ru: (Путешествуйте и наслаждайтесь видами вместе с ним...)

bd018676-769e-400e-88b4-af9cc1c27735/Eve.en: "If you don't want to help, I won't make you do it..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> fended off <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s blow, had his horse back off half a step, and then said with his hands folded...
bd018676-769e-400e-88b4-af9cc1c27735/Eve.cn: “姑娘若是不愿相助，我自然不会勉强……”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />出手挡住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一击，随后勒马退后半步，拱手说道……
bd018676-769e-400e-88b4-af9cc1c27735/Eve.ru: "Если ты не хочешь помогать, я не буду заставлять тебя это делать..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> отразил удар <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, заставил свою лошадь отступить на полшага, а затем сказал, сложив руки на груди...

bd8adc38-ae8a-4f96-9fe9-9b9edeae60ef/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked in that direction and saw that an imposing azure ox had come out of nowhere on the steppes.<NL>At the sight of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, it started galloping. Before long,<NL>it halted in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
bd8adc38-ae8a-4f96-9fe9-9b9edeae60ef/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声看去，只见草原上忽然多出了一匹神骏的青牛，<NL>它一见到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，立时发足狂奔，不多时，<NL>便来到了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身前……
bd8adc38-ae8a-4f96-9fe9-9b9edeae60ef/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> посмотрел в том направлении и увидел, что из ниоткуда в степи появился внушительный лазурный бык.<NL>При виде <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> он пустился галопом. Вскоре,<NL>он остановился перед <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

bdfa4a52-4d5e-4c48-bc29-0c20fbdd40f3/Eve.en: "It'll be best if we keep from fighting, lest you get hurt..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> fended off <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s blow, then had his horse back off half a step, and said with his hands folded...
bdfa4a52-4d5e-4c48-bc29-0c20fbdd40f3/Eve.cn: “拳脚无眼，还是不要动手为好……”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />出手挡住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一击，随后勒马退后半步，拱手说道……
bdfa4a52-4d5e-4c48-bc29-0c20fbdd40f3/Eve.ru: "Будет лучше, если мы воздержимся от драки, чтобы ты не пострадал..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> отразил удар <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, затем заставил свою лошадь отступить на полшага и сказал, сложив руки на груди...

c384a938-49f4-4c07-b361-6b6db4dbb796/Eve.en: "Accompanying you and looking for the white horse are also serious business!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> reined in his horse to have it go at a gentle pace, riding shoulder to shoulder with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
c384a938-49f4-4c07-b361-6b6db4dbb796/Eve.cn: “伴你同行，与追寻白马，同是正事！”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />勒马徐行，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />比肩同游……
c384a938-49f4-4c07-b361-6b6db4dbb796/Eve.ru: "Сопровождать тебя и искать белую лошадь - тоже серьезное дело!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> придержал коня, чтобы тот шел легким шагом, и ехал плечом к плечу с <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

c384a938-49f4-4c07-b361-6b6db4dbb796/Opt.en: (Travel and enjoy the view with him...)
c384a938-49f4-4c07-b361-6b6db4dbb796/Opt.ru: (Путешествуйте и наслаждайтесь видами вместе с ним...)

c4041dcc-e953-4915-a42f-7e093004b3a4/Eve.en: "It is indeed very dangerous for you to travel alone..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> reined in his horse to have it go at a gentle pace, riding shoulder to shoulder with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
c4041dcc-e953-4915-a42f-7e093004b3a4/Eve.cn: “姑娘孤身一人，确实颇为危险……”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />勒马徐行，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />比肩同游……
c4041dcc-e953-4915-a42f-7e093004b3a4/Eve.ru: "Для тебя действительно очень опасно путешествовать в одиночку..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> придержал коня, чтобы тот шел легким шагом, и ехал плечом к плечу с <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

c4041dcc-e953-4915-a42f-7e093004b3a4/Opt.en: (Travel and enjoy the view with him...)

c7508722-77a3-431e-8631-57de8fcc455d/Eve.en: All of a sudden, a neigh of the white horse was distantly heard, followed by a brief silence.<NL>Then a torrent of deafening cries and cheers burst forth from the steppes!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked in that direction and saw that a hero was galloping toward her, bathed in golden sunlight shining through the clouds, gusts of wind bending the grass.<NL>He looked just like the young hero depicted by the verse "The young warrior astride a white golden-bridled horse lets out a laugh that makes the welkin ring amidst the howling wind"!
c7508722-77a3-431e-8631-57de8fcc455d/Eve.cn: 忽听得远处白马嘶鸣，随着又一阵短暂的沉寂，<NL>而后草原之上不断地响起了震天的呐喊声、欢叫声！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声望去，只见，云开日现，猎风偃草，一名侠士纵马而来，<NL>当真好一个“白马金羁侠少年，风飙长笑破天骄！”

e4118ed6-63c3-4f17-8605-f1414696a464/Eve.en: "So this is the scenery of Liao.<NL>By feasting my eyes on it with you... I enjoyed myself to my heart's content..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />, after hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s praises, expressed his agreement with hands folded...
e4118ed6-63c3-4f17-8605-f1414696a464/Eve.cn: “这便是辽地风物么，<NL>与姑娘一同游赏……我十分尽兴……”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />称道，亦拱手附和……
e4118ed6-63c3-4f17-8605-f1414696a464/Eve.ru: "Итак, это и есть пейзажи Ляо.<NL>Любуясь ими вместе с вами... Я наслаждался вволю..."<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> выслушав похвалы <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, выразил свое согласие, сложив руки на груди...

e6dc1905-2e6a-420c-8ca9-0c183c39650d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, leading the azure ox along, was roaming the steppes<NL>when suddenly a figure galloped in her direction. It was <Character key= Participant str=Name />...<NL><NL>The steppes were vast. <Character key= Participant str=Name /> had been trailing the white horse for a long time, and his mount was exhausted,<NL>so he requested <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to let him ride the gray buffalo with her, and that they search for the white horse together...
e6dc1905-2e6a-420c-8ca9-0c183c39650d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />正牵着青牛在草原上四处游逛，<NL>身旁忽然驰来一道身影，原来乃是<Character key= Participant str=Name />……<NL><NL>草原辽阔，<Character key= Participant str=Name />在草原上追寻了许久的白马，身下的坐骑已是疲累不堪，<NL>故请求与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />共乘青牛，一同前去寻找白马……

ee1cf24d-d710-45ee-9b30-0b8936036302/Eve.en: "I was thinking exactly the same thing!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />, enraptured by those words, hurried up to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, held her hands and said delightedly,<NL>"In Liao people's words, I'm willing to place my faith in the spirits of the White Horse & Azure Ox,<NL>and spend the rest of my life with you..."
ee1cf24d-d710-45ee-9b30-0b8936036302/Eve.cn: “姑娘与我心意相同！”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />闻言，大喜过望，连忙上前握起了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的双手，欢喜道：<NL>“按辽人所言，在下愿依白马青牛之灵，<NL>与姑娘相依相伴，生死不离……”
ee1cf24d-d710-45ee-9b30-0b8936036302/Eve.ru: "Я думал точно о том же самом!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />, восхищенный этими словами, поспешил к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, взял ее за руки и восхищенно сказал,<NL>"По словам людей Ляо, я готов довериться духам Белого коня и Лазурного быка,<NL>и провести с тобой остаток своей жизни..."

ee1cf24d-d710-45ee-9b30-0b8936036302/Opt.ru: (Я ничего не желаю больше, чем этого!)

f08784d1-387c-4b98-9e29-0e04df64ced7/Eve.en: This foothill is also a sand dune, short and adorned with only sparse plants.<NL>All their leaves have fallen due to the snow and frost, all animals' dwelling places lost.<NL><NL>They traveled across a desert and spotted a sandy hill ahead...<NL>Rumor had it that many mausoleums had been built in this area. The hill was tall and precipitous. Most of it was in too harsh conditions for even grass to grow.<NL>But at the hilltop stood a towering tree, some of whose leaves fell with every passing wind...
f08784d1-387c-4b98-9e29-0e04df64ced7/Eve.cn: 兹山亦沙阜，短短见丛薄。<NL>冰霜叶堕尽，鸟兽纷无托。<NL><NL>走过荒漠之地，前方乃一座沙山……<NL>相传有许多陵墓建于此处，此山高峻无比，多处寸草难生，<NL>而山顶处却生有一株高大树木，随风便见木叶飘落……

f3cc3f84-7e48-46af-8ba5-65f3c6ce40f6/Eve.en: Snowflakes on the Yan Mountains, as large as bamboo mats, fell onto the Xuanyuan Platform one after another.<NL><NL>On the ground, plants were gradually giving way to snow...<NL>When a chill wind blew by, some snowflakes fell into view. She looked up<NL>and saw that the tops of the rolling mountains were covered with snow, which was a desolate yet spectacular sight...
f3cc3f84-7e48-46af-8ba5-65f3c6ce40f6/Eve.cn: 燕山雪花大如席，片片吹落轩辕台。<NL><NL>只见地面草木渐少，积雪渐生……<NL>寒风吹来，眼前竟有雪花飘落，抬头仰观，<NL>山峰连绵，山顶积雪皑皑，清冷壮观……
f3cc3f84-7e48-46af-8ba5-65f3c6ce40f6/Eve.ru: Снежинки с гор Янь, размером с бамбуковые циновки, падали на платформу Сюаньюань одна за другой.<NL><NL>На земле растения постепенно уступали место снегу...<NL>Когда подул холодный ветер, в поле зрения упало несколько снежинок. Она подняла глаза<NL>и увидел, что вершины холмистых гор были покрыты снегом, что представляло собой пустынное, но впечатляющее зрелище...

f4ef9a21-fa50-4008-986c-b2b94191398b/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> lost to <Character key= Participant str=Name /> and had no choice but to leave the place...
f4ef9a21-fa50-4008-986c-b2b94191398b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />败于<Character key= Participant str=Name />之手，只得暂时离开此地……
f4ef9a21-fa50-4008-986c-b2b94191398b/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> потерянный для <Character key= Participant str=Name /> и у него не было другого выбора, кроме как покинуть это место...

f745880a-6a3e-4088-8fa3-3db26e4dac8e/Eve.en: "If you don't want to help, just tell me. There's no need to resort to violence!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> fended off <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s blow, and then had <Character key= Participant str=GenderPossessive/> horse back off half a step and made a remark sonorously...
f745880a-6a3e-4088-8fa3-3db26e4dac8e/Eve.cn: “姑娘不愿相助，直言便是，何必施以暗害！”<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name />出手挡住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一击，随后勒马退后半步，朗声说道……
f745880a-6a3e-4088-8fa3-3db26e4dac8e/Eve.ru: - Если ты не хочешь помогать, просто скажи мне. Нет необходимости прибегать к насилию!"<NL><Character key= Participant str=Name /> отбивался <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />это был удар, а потом был <Character key= Participant str=GenderPossessive/> конь отступил на полшага и звучно произнес какое-то замечание...

fb13c671-aa56-456a-99fe-473cae5a7c09/Eve.en: Just then, someone's loud voice came from the distance,<NL>"The auspicious hour has arrived. Please mount the azure ox, Miss!"
fb13c671-aa56-456a-99fe-473cae5a7c09/Eve.cn: 这时，只听远处有人高声唱道：<NL>“吉时已到，还请姑娘乘上青牛！”
fb13c671-aa56-456a-99fe-473cae5a7c09/Eve.ru: Как раз в этот момент издалека донесся чей-то громкий голос,<NL>"Настал благоприятный час. Пожалуйста, садитесь на лазурного быка, мисс!"

fb13c671-aa56-456a-99fe-473cae5a7c09/Opt.en: (Look in the direction of the voices...)
